_method.weights_gb: params_total_b x bytes/param (bf16 2.0, fp8/int8 1.0, q4 0.56 incl. scales); for the precision the repo actually ships, the measured safetensors size (hub model-facts weights_gb) is used. MoE: total params (all experts resident).
_method.min_vram_gb: weights x 1.10 + headroom (2 GB for <=8B, 4 GB for <=35B, 8 GB above; +2 GB if the model takes images), rounded up to a GPU class (8,12,16,24,32,48,80,96,141, 2x80=160, 4x80=320, 8x80=640, 8xH200=1128).
_method.recommended: benchmarked precision (bf16 unless the repo ships fp8/nvfp4/gguf only): weights x 1.3 + headroom for batching, rounded up to a GPU class and at least one class above min when the precision is the same.
_method.ram_gb: max(16, weights x 1.2) rounded up to a RAM size class.
_method.quantisation_claims: q4 and fp8 are only offered for models whose hub fact sheet says "standard causal LM, vLLM-servable" (or already ships GGUF) and whose model_type llama.cpp supports; custom readouts, adapters, diffusion/encoder models and models without a Hugging Face fact sheet stay at bf16 (min = recommended precision). q4 is never claimed for image models.
_method.cpu_only: possible when q4 weights <= 20 GB (llama.cpp, slow), or for non-q4 models up to 1B params in PyTorch.
_method.apple_silicon: text models only, q4 weights x 1.25 must fit a unified-memory class (16/24/32/48/64/96/128/192 GB), architecture must be llama.cpp/MLX-supported.
_method.installer_catalog: The 18 hub models that have an installer catalog entry copy its hand-verified variant numbers (GPU variants: min = smallest min_vram_gb, recommended = recommended_vram_gb of the benchmarked variant); cpu/mps variants drive cpu_only / apple_silicon.
_method.cloud: Cheapest on-demand Linux instance whose total GPU memory >= the class, among a fixed candidate list (T4 excluded: no bf16/fp8). usd_per_hour is the cheapest checked EU region (price_region); usd_per_hour_us is the US reference. Multi-GPU instances need tensor parallelism. AWS prices: Vantage aggregator of the AWS price list; Azure: official Retail Prices API; GCP: Cyclenerd pricing dataset derived from the Cloud Billing catalog. Treat as list prices of 2026-10-10.
_method.unknown: Models without a Hugging Face repo, params string or usable base-model info get source "unknown", numbers null (page: "on request").
